text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the clinical staff, specifically mentioning Dr. Yu, Dr. Slack, Dr. Powers, and Dr. Mai for their patience and expertise. Reviewers appreciate that doctors take time to answer questions thoroughly. While one client noted mixed impressions with front desk staff, overall feedback for the veterinary team remains overwhelmingly warm.

title.en: Gentle care for diverse companion animals

text.en: Clients frequently highlight the team's gentle handling of both common and non-traditional pets, including turtles, budgies, and tortoises. Dog owners also commend special fear-free appointments with quiet pacing for reactive rescues. Reviewers emphasize that examinations are conducted calmly to minimize distress for nervous pets.

title.en: Effective diagnostic and routine medical care

text.en: Reviewers report positive outcomes across a variety of medical visits, from urgent gastrointestinal issues and eye treatments to wellness checkups. Pet parents note that pets recover smoothly with clear care regimes and necessary medications. The practice is trusted by local families for delivering dependable treatment results.

q.en: Does Heights Veterinary Clinic Northwest treat avian and exotic pets?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention successful visits for birds, turtles, tortoises, and other exotic animals with specialized veterinarians like Dr. Yu.

q.en: How does the clinic handle reactive or anxious pets?

a.en: Reviewers note that the clinic offers fear-free appointments with slower pacing and extra time to keep anxious and reactive pets calm.

q.en: Can urgent cases or emergencies be accommodated?

a.en: Yes, pet parents report that the staff has squeezed in sick pets for same-day evaluation during urgent situations.
